messages:
sophie: Published the RCA for last night's serving degradation — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-3421
sophie: Short summary: routing-policy mismatch + stale prefix cache caused a fallback loop on a subset of Dedicated pools. Customer impact ~45m during peak, ~12% increased token latency for affected requests.
sophie: Mitigations applied during incident: reverted routing rule, increased KV cache eviction threshold, and temporarily bumped capacity for 2 affected pools.
ajay: Thanks Sophie. Can you call out the highest-priority action items here so we can assign owners quickly?
sophie: Sure — high-level actions:
- A1: Harden routing policy validation + unit tests (owner: maria)
- A2: Make cache eviction behavior explicit in runtime config (owner: chris)
- A3: Add alert + dashboard for fallback-loop patterns (owner: dylan)
- A4: Post-deploy canary that verifies route compatibility (owner: maria)
maria: I can take A1 & A4. A1: will add a preflight check and test harness. ETA: EOD Thu.
chris: Taking A2. I'll add config flags and document in runtime README. Plan to open PR by tomorrow morning.
dylan: A3 here — I'll add a graph for fallback rate and a pager rule (low-priority severity 3) plus a weekly digest to SLO channel.
ajay: maria/chris/dylan — can you each confirm a checkpoint date? I'd like a 1-week and 30-day check.
maria: 1-week checkpoint: 2025-05-08, 30-day checkpoint: 2025-06-05. I'll put details in the RCA.
chris: 1-week ok for me, will prep a short runbook snippet for ops.
dylan: ACK for both. I'll include the dashboard links in the checkpoint notes.
incident-bot: RCA document updated by sophie. Title: "Serving fallback loop — routing policy mismatch" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-3421
ajay: Great. Please add the PR links here as they land so we can track closure in the RCA.
sophie: Will do. Also adding a notes section for customer comms and contact list for follow-ups.
maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/289 — includes routing validation tests.
chris: Draft PR for config flags: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/790 — WIP, comments welcome.
dylan: Monitoring PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/412 — adding fallback metrics and alert rule.
ajay: Thanks everyone. We'll review progress in the 1-week checkpoint. If anything blocks, post here or ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
sophie: Calendar invite sent for the 1-week checkpoint (2025-05-08 10:00 PT). I'll post a reminder 24h before.
maria: Starting work now, will post status updates to this thread. :rocket:
chris: I'll coordinate the runtime docs update and link it in the RCA once merged.
dylan: I'll schedule the dashboard review with SRE next week.
ajay: Closing thread for now — tracking continues in RCA and via PRs. Thanks all. :pray:
